preconditions.description: The number of planets n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of plans q must be between 1 and 100000.
The index of earth s must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan type t must be 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for v, u, w in plans if t == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 plans, v and u must be valid planet indices and w must be a valid cost.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= l <= r <= n and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for v, l, r, w in plans if t in (2, 3))
preconditions.description: For type 2 and 3 plans, v must be a valid planet index, l and r must be valid ranges, and w must be a valid cost.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must be either a non-negative cost or -1.
The cost to reach the earth (planet s) must be 0.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == -1 or int(stdout.split()[i]) >= 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each planet, the output must indicate either the minimum cost or -1 if unreachable.
